name: ErrorState
usage: Failed requests for a list or details, lost connection to a service, missing permissions

props.name: message
props.description: Description of the error: a text readable by users, converted from the error; never show the raw exception.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry: when provided, a "Retry" button is shown.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `md` for a whole page or a large area, `sm` inside lists and panels.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fills the height of the parent and centers the content.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Replaces the content when a request fails and offers a retry. `message` is converted, user-readable text; do
not show the raw exception.
